data.name: Cultic Study
data.description: A cult hunter can spend 8 hours studying a specific deity or religion to gain a +%1 bonus on Bluff, Intimidate, Knowledge, Perception, and Sense Motive checks against followers of that deity or religion and against extraplanar creatures. If he studies a new deity or religion, the bonuses replace the former bonuses.|InvestigatorLVL/4
